name: caption-dim-progress
title: Caption Dim Progress
description: The whole phrase sits on screen dimmed and each word brightens the moment it is spoken, with no motion at all.
useWhen: Captions have to be read rather than watched: tutorials, explainers, accessibility-first edits where nothing should move.
You want the viewer to read ahead while still seeing exactly where the voice is, without color or animation competing with the footage.
avoidWhen: You want the position of the voice to feel physical, filling through each word: use caption-karaoke.
You want a colored marker that travels from word to word: use caption-underline or caption-highlight-box.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow behind the text for legibility on footage.

variables.label: Upcoming opacity
variables.description: Opacity of words that have not been spoken yet.
